title: Brewster lights over the haunted-house garage

tellings.quote:
And he shows me, you know, we look up
and there's these six bright white
lights at the top of the trees just
hanging over the trees, just going over
the road, just uh, you know, not moving
very fast, just just hanging hanging out
in formation. No sound, no window,
nothing.

plain: Around 1985 or 1986 in Brewster, New York, six bright white lights hung in formation at the tops of the trees by the garage of a house said to be haunted, then drifted slowly over the road with no sound. Charles Buhler, a NASA engineer, tells Michels he saw them himself after someone took him outside and showed him: "No sound, no window, nothing." For Buhler it was an early sighting of something that moved like no aircraft he knew.
